gen-fs-nippo-gf-noto-sans-warang-citi: Wire-cut strokes with small letters standing nearly capital-sized give Nippo a technical edge that no hairline or swell ever softens. Nippo grabs attention; Noto Sans Warang Citi keeps the words solid.
gen-fs-nippo-gf-noto-sans-zanabazar-squa: Nippo's wire-like strokes and proud little lowercase feel technical, with no thick-thin swing anywhere. Noto Sans Zanabazar Square responds with wide gaps and a soaring x-height, friendly where Nippo is exacting.
gen-fs-nippo-gf-numans: Nippo's small letters stand nearly capital-sized, cut like wire. Numans loosens everything with generous tracking and hanging s ends, so the wiry compactness above it becomes the pair's whole appeal.
gen-fs-nippo-gf-open-sans: Nippo has strokes that resemble a bent paperclip. Open Sans supplies smooth, bulky lowercase underneath, so the wiry headline and the sturdy text each keep a clear job.
gen-fs-nippo-gf-savate: Savate has sturdy hairlines and open jaws on every curve, its round o nearly a capital. And paragraphs in it should flow smoothly beneath Nippo, whose wire-drawn strokes stay uniform.
gen-fs-nippo-gf-schibsted-grotesk: Nippo draws small letters nearly capital-sized with no hairlines anywhere, giving the headings a technical, wire-cut look. Schibsted Grotesk then opens everything up, friendly and generous beneath that wiry line.
gen-fs-nippo-gf-sen: Sen builds towering lowercase with a constant-weight line. Nippo's wire-cut, nearly capital-sized small letters echo that line, and the shared linear spirit is what holds the pair together.
gen-fs-nippo-gf-sintony: Sintony reads smooth and chunky, with no clogged curves. Nippo is best at turning heads with its steel-cable outline strokes, while Sintony handles the steady work of the text.
gen-fs-nippo-gf-sofia-sans: Sofia Sans has rounded letters with a clearly open side and no thick-and-thin modulation. Sofia Sans quietly carries the text like cut acrylic stencil pieces while Nippo takes the technical spotlight.
gen-fs-nippo-gf-sono: Sono spaces its lowercase generously, each a with its mouth left ajar. Sono leaves room to breathe under Nippo's wire-cut, technical lettering, which stays compact and nearly capital-sized.
